name: air_intercept_a_hop_and_a_whiff_nets_about_zero
description: The car holds jump for 3 steps (a full-height hop, about 200 uu) under a ball that floats at z 1500, then lands without ever getting near it. Phi is tiny in the air (carFrac under 0.4, ball 1300 uu away) and 0 on the ground, so the climb is refunded on landing: the sum is only the discount leak (gamma - 1) * the few Phi values, under 0.01 in size. The ball starts with a 1 uu/s upward velocity on purpose: in the engine a ball set with EXACTLY zero velocity in the air does not fall (it floats, measured), while any nonzero velocity makes it fall normally. Training's state setters all give the ball a random nonzero velocity.

expect.intent: a hop toward a high ball and a landing nets about zero (never positive): the attempt is nearly free
